_comment: Off-chain annotations keyed by outcome-token id. The chain knows a position was sold; it cannot know WHY. Entries here override the default 'Sold' label on closed positions. kind: 'manual' marks a discretionary close (our own decision, not a followed signal); 'reason' is shown on the row.
